name: Chikai no Kiss to Nanatsu no Yuuwaku
original_name: 誓いのキスと7つの誘惑
source:
You were just a typical officer worker dreaming of a happy marriage.
Now the company's alpha males are proposing to you...?!
Each tries to seduce you, all sharing one goal...
Marry you... to become CEO!

Is this true love that simply started as a political marriage?

[Source: [url=http://koi-game.voltage.co.jp/romance/]Voltage[/url]]
